atlas_description: Cohort-level population statistics, relatedness, Mendelian + dyad/trio gates, pedigree inference from regimes, ancestry painting. Hosts Cluster 4 of the haplotype-regimes pipeline (regime_mendelian, regime_dyad_mendelian, regime_pedigree, regime_linkage) and the MSMC demographic validation SPEC. Reads inversion.candidates_v1 + inversion.regime_catalogue_v1 (read-only) via cross_atlas_imports.

pages.label: popstats
pages.tooltip: Per-candidate cohort statistics: π, FST, dXY, HWE, F_IS, allele-frequency drift, private/fixed counts. Consumes inversion.candidates_v1.

pages.label: ancestry per window
pages.tooltip: Per-window ancestry painting across the chromosome.

pages.label: fish ancestry
pages.tooltip: Per-fish ancestry painting across one inversion candidate. Headline metric: mean |ΔQ| (global vs local). See specs_done/SPEC_fish_ancestry_scroller.md.
